theorems.name: Submission.lusin_compact_exhaustion_of_measurable
theorems.statement: ∀ {Y : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y] [FiniteDimensional ℝ Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] (n : ℕ) (g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → Y) (S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))), Measurable g → MeasurableSet S → volume S ≠ ⊤ → ∃ C : ℕ → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), (∀ j, IsCompact (C j) ∧ C j ⊆ S ∧ ContinuousOn g (C j)) ∧ volume (S \ ⋃ j, C j) = 0
